description: Singapore open data portal (data.gov.sg) is an open data portal listed in Singapore open data portal (data.gov.sg), an open data portal, published or maintained by Government Technology Agency of Singapore (data.gov.sg). Singapore open data portal (data.gov.sg). This harvest searched it with infrastructure and hazard phrases in English and English and read 4,628 datasets; the ones whose titles name a transport, energy, water, digital or facility element or a hazard are catalogued as records of their own, and the rest (statistics, laws, contracts, culture, health and similar) ... Coverage: Singapore. 4,628 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 233 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sg-dgs-portal.
